aros-rom.bin and aros-ext.bin are the AROS replacement Kickstart ROMs for the Amiga (m68k build),
used by the tests only. They are distributed under the AROS Public License:
https://aros.sourceforge.io/license.html

AROS source code: https://github.com/aros-development-team/AROS
